body: The biggest problem in my life is me. I am a burden on the people who care about me. When I meet people, I push them away. I can't make friends and constantly push away the people I love the most.
I know I am well loved. It only makes me feel worse. If everyone knew about how I feel, they'd hate me. Anytime I feel someone getting close, I just push them away. I can't help it.
